notes: No masculine or feminine singular "you": no present-tense participles or future forms for the player (אתה בונה / תבני); past second-person forms are written unpointed (בנית, פספסת), which do not mark gender.

Nothing agrees in gender with {name}, {building}, {troop} or another player: event lines put the placeholder after a colon (פשיטה על הכפר שלך: {arg1}, הבנייה הושלמה: {arg1}), and verbs about other players are passive or nominal.
No Hebrew prefix letter (ב, ה, ו, כ, ל, מ, ש) is attached to a name placeholder; number placeholders take a prefix only with a maqaf (ב־{n}), as Hebrew writes prefixes before digits.
Plural categories follow Intl.PluralRules("he"): one, two, other; every plural has all three branches.

Generated names should use generatedNames "noun-first": second parts are nouns in construct state (פסגת, עמק, מסכת), first parts definite nouns (הרעם, הערפל, חצות), so פסגת + הרעם = פסגת הרעם. No adjectives, so nothing has to agree in gender.
Japanese names are transliterated into Hebrew letters (קאיטו, טאקדה, גורו); Sensei Hoshi is סנסאי הושי, Kage League ליגת קאגה (distinct from ליגת הצל).
The Japanese statutory pages are translated into Hebrew (as in vi), with the English duplicate spans left empty; the support page links them by their Japanese titles.
No direction marks: the game sets dir="rtl". Hebrew is not yet activated (integration step: generatedNames, compiled catalog, release test, native resources).
